title: Check for Missing Citation Keys in a BibTeX File — xct_bib_keys_missing
text: path_bib file path bibliography file (.bib) used citation keys. Defaults "references.bib" current working directory. keys_missing character vector citation keys missing BibTeX file. Typically obtained using xct_bib_keys_missing(). keys_bib character vector citation keys extracted BibTeX file. Typically obtained using xct_bib_keys_extract(). stringdist_threshold numeric maximum allowable string distance match considered valid. value passed [stringdist::stringdist()] specified method. Distances non-negative numeric values smaller values indicate greater similarity. short strings (5-10 characters), use 1-3; medium strings (10-20 characters), use 3-7; longer strings (>20 characters), use 7-15. Default 15. Interestingly, see accurate matches 25 however also get mismatches go high result incorrect citations find replace !! stringdist_method character method used [stringdist::stringdist()] calculate string distances. Options include "osa" (Optimal String Alignment, default), "lv" (Levenshtein), "dl" (Damerau-Levenshtein), "jw" (Jaro-Winkler), others. See [stringdist::stringdist()] documentation details. Default "dl". no_match_rows_include logical Whether include rows keys valid matches output. Default FALSE, excludes rows. keys character vector citation keys check BibTeX file.

title: Check for Missing Citation Keys in a BibTeX File — xct_bib_keys_missing
text: vector citation keys missing BibTeX file. Returns empty vector citation keys found. character vector citation keys extracted BibTeX file. data frame two columns: key_missing missing citation keys. key_missing_guess_match guessed closest matching citation keys (NA valid match found). no_match_rows_include = FALSE, rows valid matches excluded.
